Context: 3. Date of Birth and its subsequent alteration

4. Belated claims for alteration in Date of Birth to be rejected. Government policy regarding rejection of belated claim for alteration in date of birth is reinforced by the Apex Court judgments in two cases. It will not be appropriate to consider any request for alteration in Date of Birth if the conditions stipulated in Para. 3 above are not strictly fulfilled.
- OM, dated 19-5-1993 and OM, dated 16-12-2014, Chapter 58.
